title: ScreenVerdict
description: One relevance/scope decision for a snapshot from a screening workflow (annotate.screen). A filter flag, not evidence: it routes the snapshot into or out of downstream annotate scopes; it is never admitted into an aggregate as content. One row per (snapshot, workflow), item_key=''. Quote-free; if the verdict cites text, the quote is on the envelope grounding and referenced by grounding_idx.

verdict.description: enums.yaml relevance_verdict. relevant = keep for downstream extraction; irrelevant = out of scope; borderline = kept but flagged for cheaper handling / review.

rationale.description: Why this verdict — the auditable reason a scope cell is (not) populated.

buckets.description: Coarse routing buckets the snapshot matched (enums.yaml triage_bucket); drives which downstream workflows claim it.

off_topic_reason.description: Present when verdict=irrelevant: the specific scope non-goal it fell into.
